Stash Browser design and autocomplete endpoint reference
https://github.com/Codename-11/Stash-Downloader
Reference commit: 842621160cddf9b7b12c7c2b51ef489a98a191b4

The browser sidebar, search chips, card actions and live autocomplete approach
were adapted to StashBooru's native components and server infrastructure.
